name: agentic-sdlc
description: An agent-based SDLC pipeline that is enforced, not suggested: specify, review the spec, branch, implement, verify, review, gate, land, report. Each stage has one owning agent and leaves a receipt bound to a commit; a PreToolUse hook refuses a branch without an approved spec, a push to the trunk without a passed gate, and a merge without a READY verdict. Stack-agnostic through one detected adapter file; speaks OpenSpec or PRD/FRD. Run /agentic-sdlc:init in any repo.
